Container.Name: u1-print-bridge-api
Container.Overview: One-click print bridge API for the Snapmaker U1: paste a model link or upload a 3MF, check the color to slot mapping, and start multi-color prints from your phone. Pair with the u1-print-bridge-slicer container sharing the same Data path.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the print-bridge web UI and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Job database and slice artifacts. MUST be the same path in the api and slicer containers.

Config.Name: Spoolman URL
Config.Description: Spoolman filament inventory (read-only for the bridge).

Config.Name: ntfy Topic
Config.Description: ntfy topic for pipeline alerts. Empty disables alerts.

Config.Name: Bridge URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of this bridge, used for ntfy deep links. Leave empty when not set.

Config.Name: MakerWorld Session Cookie
Config.Description: Optional logged-in MakerWorld session cookie for best-effort downloads. Leave empty for manual-upload fallback.

Config.Name: Data Dir
Config.Description: Data directory inside the container. Keep /data.
